Umar al-Khattab, Muhammad's father-in-law, was watching women relieving themselves outside at night and was upset to find the large, elderly Sawda up close, so he urged Allah to reveal the 'al-hijab' verses (Source: Sahih Bukhari 146). That's the origin of the hijab in Islam, so shameful.

Sources: 

Sahih al-Bukhari 146:

Narrated 'Aisha: The wives of the Prophet used to go to Al-Manasi—a vast open place (near Baqi' in Medina)—to answer the call of nature at night. 'Umar used to say to the Prophet, 'Let your wives be veiled,' but the Messenger of Allah did not do so. One night, Sawda bint Zam'a, the wife of the Prophet, went out at 'Isha' time, and she was a tall lady. 'Umar addressed her and said, 'I have recognized you, O Sawda.' He did so because he eagerly desired that the verses of al-hijab be revealed. So Allah revealed the verses of al-hijab.

Look up the 'al-hijab' verses: 33:53 (primary 'verse of hijab'), 33:55, 33:59.

What is the meaning of jalabab?

Jalabib جَلاَبِيْبٌ is the plural of jilbabجِلْبَابٌ , which means a loose outer garment.
